summary: EHang Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The report details sales of four EH216 series eVTOL units, revenues of RMB25.7 million, a gross margin of 62.5%, and a net loss of RMB126.4 million. There is no transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation event.
